event: Wren takes the hooded blue lantern from under the steering-bench and recites the signal.
Alan lights it: it burns cold and sick, quenched in the same Well as their iron.

event: Tygryth poles them off the jetty, slow, into black water.
The far shore resolves: a half-drowned quay below a vast sunken sanctuary.

memory.fact: A half-drowned stone quay with pilings is the Stillwater's landing.

event: Alan feels a slow tired ache under the closed stone eye: the one they keep.
The dock flashes twice; Tygryth answers once, and the poles are shipped.

memory.fact: The Stillwater dock signalled two flashes; a barge answered one and shipped its poles.

event: The hull touches the quay; a tally-man bends over the covered cargo.
Alan breaks the tally-man's neck: the signal to act.
Tygryth pours out the hush and takes the two slavers at the rail.
The black-scaled girl silences a cage-hand and opens his throat: one.
Wren lashes the barge fast to the quay.
The fourth man swings the alarm bar; Tygryth takes him, but the plate gives one dull note.
